verdict.rationale: Baseten's general-purpose deployment stack (Truss, custom Python model classes, support for transformers/vLLM/etc.) means a developer could deploy an embedding or reranker model on dedicated infrastructure without a second vendor, and one community post references building a client for OpenAI-compatible embeddings servers (infinity, TEI, vLLM, sglang) that could run on Baseten. However, there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated embeddings or reranking Model API, no named embedding/rerank model catalog, and no worked example of an embeddings/retrieval pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit embeddings API docs, reranking model support/docs, and a concrete retrieval-pipeline example or benchmark.
